title: Building Resilience with Atomic File Operations
excerpt: How temporary files, atomic renames, and in-process lock managers protect your data without a SQL engine.

blocks.text: Writing directly to destination files risks partial writes during power failures or server reboots. By writing to a randomized temporary file, flushing, and using OS-level atomic renames, corrupted files become impossible.

author: Security Engineer
